title: Dance Tonight! Revolution Tomorrow!
desc_lfm_album: Dance Tonight! Revolution Tomorrow! is the second studio album by Emoviolence band Orchid, released on December 4th, 2000 under Ebullition Records. Ebullition was known for signing early pioneers of Screamo and emoviolence, such as Portraits of Past and Reversal of Man. Dance Tonight! Revolution Tomorrow! was recorded at God City Studios in December of 1999, a studio that Converge guitarist Kurt Ballou established in 1998. The album shifts away from the raw, dark, and extreme Powerviolence derived sound orchid had previously established with their debut album Chaos Is Me and completely flips it over it's head. title: Chaos Is Me
desc_lfm_album: Chaos Is Me is the debut studio album by American emoviolence band Orchid. It was released in 1999 through Ebullition Records. Chaos Is Me heralded the change of the guard for extreme music, and brought both Amherst, Massachusetts and Hampshire College to the forefront of the scene's attention. The album was produced by Kurt Ballou at God City Studios in Spring 1999. .
